name: convolve the samples with a windowed sinc kernel
mechanism: each output value is a weighted sum of the nearby input samples, the weights being an ideal reconstruction kernel (sinc) multiplied by a window that cuts it off after a few lobes; the window trades ringing against blur

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Lanczos resampling ("Lanzosh")' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Interpolation and extrapolation: a multivariate interpolation method used to compute new values for any digitally sampled data
